notes: «- هو خالد بن دينار -» is an editor identification: left out (Abu Khalda is written as in the text)
«قال يونس بن بكير أخبرنا أبو خلدة فقال بالصلاة» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group

«وقال بشر بن ثابت حدثنا أبو خلدة قال صلى بنا أمير الجمعة ثم قال لأنس ...» gives a second saying with its own isnad (a question to Anas about the Dhuhr prayer) and the text is cut off: a second saying with its own isnad is rule 11, so the ruling is open and the group is not written
